name: Farmboy And The Wolf
source:
Farmboy And The Wolf is a coming-of-age story that follows two main characters, both 18 years old: Jesse "the farmboy" and Nathaniel "the wolf".

Nathaniel is forced to move to the farmland with his family, where, against his choice, he volunteers to work on the farm. This is where he meets Jesse, which quickly leads to a mix of emotions and tension between them.

[From [url=https://jordynstr8.itch.io/farmboy-and-the-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
